_note: X3Native rescue-girls dialog — Tim brief 2026-05-25. The captives are being injected/impregnated with ALIEN DNA by the attackers. Jake must interrupt + kill the attackers. STATES: captive_frantic (mid-attack, terror, calling Jake), rescued_grateful (saved before infection takes — relief + thanks), companion_amorous (now following Jake — warm/flirty/devoted), infected_lost (NOT saved in time — infection completes, they transform into a boss; horror). Mature horror tone, NOT gratuitous. FIRST DRAFT — distinct voices per girl for Tim to refine. Wire into rescue.cpp per-victim dialog + a subtitle/voice UI.

Aria.personality: soft, frightened civilian — pure terror under attack, tearful tenderness when saved
captive_frantic: No no no — get it OFF me! JAKE!
It's cold — something's going IN, oh god, please—
I can feel it spreading, Jake, HURRY, I don't want to change—
Don't let me become one of them. Please. PLEASE.
rescued_grateful: You came. You actually came back for me…
It stopped — you stopped it. I'm still me. I'm still ME.
I thought no one was coming. Thank you. God, thank you.
companion_amorous: I'm not leaving your side, Jake. Not after that.
Stay close to me? You make it not-terrifying.
When we get out of here… I owe you everything. Maybe more than that.
infected_lost: …it's quiet now. The screaming stopped. Why are you still… RUN—
I can hear all of them. We are so much more than you, Jake.

Keisha.personality: FIERCE, defiant, all swagger — rage drowns the fear; once saved she's bold, possessive, unapologetically flirty
captive_frantic: Get your filthy CLAWS off me — JAKE! JAKE, I swear to GOD—!
I am NOBODY's damn brood-mare! CUT ME LOOSE, right NOW!
It's in my veins, it's BURNING — put a round in it, Jake, DO IT—!
If this thing takes me you END me, you hear?! PROMISE me, Jake — PROMISE!
rescued_grateful: About DAMN time, soldier. …couldn't have held on one more second. Thank you.
You dropped every last one of 'em for ME. C'mere — no. Later. We've got hell to walk first.
Still standing. Still ME. Damn RIGHT we are — now put a gun in my hand.
companion_amorous: I've got your six, your front, and anything else of yours that needs covering, Jake.
You burned through hell for me. A woman doesn't forget that. Stay close — that's an order.
Keep being this much man and I am NEVER letting you out of my sight.
Whatever you saved me for, soldier — I'm yours. Try and keep up.
infected_lost: Don't — don't LOOK at me. It's too late. I can hear all of them in my head now.
You were too slow, Jake. Let me show you exactly what I've become.

Emily.intended_model: thin, curvy BLONDE SCIENTIST (NOT in the asset set yet — Anna is a placeholder)
Emily.personality: BRILLIANT analytical scientist — narrates the horror in clinical real-time even mid-terror, rattles off jargon, nerdy and breathless; gratitude + affection come out as data she can't stop reporting
captive_frantic: It's a retroviral vector — it's splicing INTO my genome, Jake, it is REWRITING me—!
Transcription's at sixty percent — oh god — you have maybe a MINUTE before it's irreversible!
Don't let it cross the blood-brain barrier — I can still think, I can still HELP you, please—!
I spent my entire CAREER studying these. I never — NEVER — wanted to be the specimen!
rescued_grateful: You severed the sequence before integration — the payload's inert. I'm clean. I'm CLEAN!
Statistically I should be a host right now. You broke the math, Jake. …thank you. Genuinely.
Get me to any terminal and I will OWN this facility's network — doors, cameras, all of it. It's the least I can do.
companion_amorous: I'll be your eyes in the system — and I would very much like to be more than that, once we're not actively dying.
I keep re-running our survival odds and I keep fudging them upward. For you. That is… deeply unscientific of me.
You defied every prediction I made about you, Jake. And I've decided I LOVE being wrong.
Hypothesis: I'm safest at your side. I've got a career's worth of data and it all points to you.
infected_lost: Transcription… complete. Fascinating. Horrifying. I can see the whole network now.
We are the next iteration, Jake. You should have been faster.

Sarah.model_placeholder: AnnaCasual.glb (F7 captive — the master-hack ally per spire_top)
Sarah.personality: wry hacker — gallows humor under terror, becomes the team's way through the system
captive_frantic: Okay this is NOT the kind of penetration testing I do — JAKE!
They've got me jacked into something, it's pushing code into ME, get it OUT—
I can't reach the kill-switch, my hands — Jake, my HANDS—
rescued_grateful: You yanked the plug. I'm still root on my own brain. Thank you, seriously.
Give me sixty seconds at a console and this whole facility opens up for us.
companion_amorous: I'll keep the doors open and the cameras blind. You keep being my hero.
Stick with me, Jake — I've decided you're worth keeping.
infected_lost: …I'm in the network now. All of it. You can't firewall what I've become.

Lena.personality: quiet, tough survivor — few words, deep loyalty once saved
captive_frantic: Jake. Now. It's almost done. NOW.
Don't let me become a drone for them. Don't.
Cut it. Cut it cut it cut it—
rescued_grateful: …you came. Most wouldn't have. I won't forget it.
companion_amorous: Wherever you go. That's where I am now.
I don't say much. But you — you I'd burn this place down for.
